domain_hint: Ti-6Al-4V avionics bracket FEA under random vibration and quasi-static loads for a lunar lander panel interface
ambiguity_notes:
- Stability with mesh/contact: memo claims <2% stress change, but also reports 12% change and hotspot migration when contact/preload are modeled.
- Loads and fixtures: summary slide says modal difference <3% with test, yet text shows 155 Hz vs 142 Hz unless elastic supports are used.
- Material inputs: stated use of cryogenic properties from MMPDS, but baseline runs used room-temperature CMTR values; some plots labeled “cryo” were not.
- Test correlation: document says “<10% at gauges,” while detailed numbers are 11–22% depending on support/friction choice.
- Configuration control/software QA: two similarly named models with different material cards; reliance on an untested Python postprocessor.
